decision.explanation: The question asks which person or organization Tingju Zhu worked for. Two distinct pieces of evidence from separate documents provide conflicting affiliations for the same individual. Document d1 (D1S3) explicitly states that Tingju Zhu was affiliated with the International Food Policy Research Institute (IFPRI), citing extensive supporting details such as co-authored papers and institutional records. Document d2 (D2S9) places Tingju Zhu at Royal Gwent Hospital as a researcher. Since both claims originate from independent sources and describe different contexts (global food policy vs. hospital research), they are treated as distinct valid answers. There is no indication that these are contradictory descriptions of the same entity, nor is there evidence to prioritize one over the other.
